title: 7,500 Light-Years From Earth, A Cat’s Head Appears - Nautilus
gist: NASA released Hubble and James Webb images of the Cat's Head Nebula, a part of the Carina Nebula about 7,500 light-years away that is not newly discovered but newly nicknamed, sculpted by ultraviolet radiation and stellar winds from massive stars.

insights.claim: NASA published images from its Hubble and James Webb Space telescopes of a region of the Carina Nebula resembling an upright cat with a glowing eye.
